# Aatir Nadim — Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio for Aatir Nadim, a software engineer focused on backend systems, distributed storage, cloud platforms, and developer tooling. The site presents selected work, professional experience, writing, certificates, and contact/profile links.

The canonical website is <https://aatirnadim.dev/>. It is a single-page portfolio; its main sections cover overview, experience, selected projects, expertise, writing, certificates, FAQ, and contact.

## Selected projects

- [getMe](https://github.com/AatirNadim/getMe): Persistent, embeddable log-structured key-value storage engine in Go, with append-only storage, in-memory indexing, crash recovery, background compaction, SDKs, and an MCP server. [Project demo](https://getme-kv.vercel.app/) · [Technical write-up](https://techtom.hashnode.dev/building-getme-i)
- [plan-parse](https://github.com/AatirNadim/plan-parse): Terraform plan workbench for exploring dependency graphs and auditing change impact and replacement risk.
- [Window](https://github.com/AatirNadim/window): Browser-based peer-to-peer file transfer using WebRTC data channels and WebSocket signaling.
